description.value: Pho Japolo is a proudly family-run Vietnamese and Japanese fusion restaurant that has been serving the Lower Mainland since 1995, growing from a single storefront to four locations. The Richmond outpost offers hearty bowls of beef noodle soup alongside inventive sushi creations like the signature sushi pizza. It is a sit-down restaurant with takeout available, making it a practical and satisfying stop for cyclists needing a substantial meal.
